integrity: A complete argument and an independently executable illustrative finite symbolic checker are included. The infinite claims depend on the analytic proof, not on finite checking.
scientific_limitations: Proved for irrational b >= 10 using graph capture and graph-dynamics theorems from cited prior literature. Rational b and smaller parameters are unproved; complete line arrangement, quantitative capture rates, and independent publication-priority confirmation are not supplied.
title: Full-plane three-cycle capture and a one-dimensional exceptional set in an absolute-value map
